Thanks for visiting Nebraska Medicine's YouTube channel. We hope our videos provide education and information about a variety of medical topics. Our videos cannot diagnose or treat any medical condition. We always try to respond to comments and questions, but remember, medical questions are best answered in person by a health care provider. When leaving comments, please do not disclose personal health information about anyone. Please keep comments civil and polite.
Nebraska Medicine can be found on line at http://www.nebraskamed.com. 

Nebraska Medicine is the most esteemed academic health care system in the region, offering exceptional patient care combined with innovative research and education. Committed to advancing the quality of health care, Nebraska Medicine represents the clinical integration of The Nebraska Medical Center, the state’s largest and highest rated hospital, Bellevue Medical Center and UNMC Physicians.
